description: Controls that verify the assurance platform itself. A platform that cannot prove its own integrity cannot credibly prove anything else.

controls.name: Descriptor Schema Validation
controls.description: Every control descriptor in infra/assurance/descriptors/ must validate against descriptor-v1.json. A descriptor with a typo, missing required field, or invalid lifecycle value must be caught before it silently produces invalid evidence.

breakTest.description: Inject an invalid lifecycle value ('Imaginary') into one descriptor → validation must fail

controls.name: Evidence Schema Validation
controls.description: Every evidence entry produced by register-evidence.sh or runner.mjs must validate against evidence-v2.json. A schema violation in a production evidence entry is a tamper indicator.

breakTest.description: Inject a missing required field into a synthetic evidence entry → schema validator must reject it

controls.name: Runner Determinism
controls.description: Running the gate runner twice against the same commit and descriptor set must produce identical currentHash values for all PROVEN controls. Non-deterministic evidence cannot be used as audit proof.

breakTest.description: Inject a random salt into the hash input → two runs must produce different hashes, proving the determinism check is real

controls.name: Hash Chain Integrity
controls.description: Verify that every evidence entry's previousHash matches the currentHash of its predecessor. A broken chain is a tamper indicator. This control runs on the full evidence history, not just the latest entry.

breakTest.description: Modify the currentHash of a historical entry → chain verification must report BROKEN_CHAIN at the tampered entry

controls.name: CEC Computation Determinism
controls.description: The CEC score computed from a fixed evidence set must be identical on every run. The score is deterministic arithmetic — any variance indicates a bug in the computation or non-deterministic evidence loading.

breakTest.description: Change one control's cec_weight mid-computation → recomputed score must differ, proving the determinism check catches the change
